name: hugo-mod-plantuml-vendored
description: Declares the third-party libraries this module vendors under assets/libs/. Never installed at build time or at runtime: it exists so Dependabot tracks their versions and GitHub raises security alerts on the code we actually ship. See ../VENDORED.md.

plantuml.js.note: PlantUML compiled to JavaScript with TeaVM, taken from the js-plantuml archive attached to the release. PlantUML publishes no npm package, so Dependabot cannot bump this pin; .github/workflows/plantuml-release.yml opens an issue when a newer release appears.
